criteria.intention: Record the verifier's observation before settling the episode.
criteria.expected_change: An evidence record exists for gate G3 with the verifier as source.
invariants: No frozen criterion is edited after the freeze.
criteria.success_region: Evidence record present, source independent of the executor.
criteria.failure_region: No evidence record, or the source is the executor only.
falsifiers: Evidence record absent after the executor reports done.
